title: Mongo: live replica-set status
description: Runs `nexus status mongo` against the running nexus-rs. Shows the 3 members' roles + health + the elected leader.

observe.what: 3-row table: 1 role=primary + 2 role=secondary; status=alive for all; leader=<primary>
JSON ClusterStatusOutputJson with 3 members + overallHealth=green + leader set

whatProves: MongoAdapter.GetStatusAsync authenticates as nexus-cluster-admin (password from Vault KV), runs rs.status() over mTLS, and parses members + the PRIMARY leader.
